description: This file defines a React utility function 'reactify' that converts a render function into a React component class, including lifecycle management and ref handling. It also exports related types for React component props and lifecycle callbacks.

classes.name: ReactifiedComponent
classes.description: A React component class created by the 'reactify' function that manages rendering via a provided render function and handles lifecycle events.

methods.name: reactify
methods.description: A higher-order function that takes a render function and optional lifecycle callbacks, returning a React component class that manages rendering and lifecycle.
